The dog needs the dog.

Round($x, True) >>> Rough($x, True) ::: If something is round then it is rough.
Visits($x, Rabbit, True) && Needs($x, BaldEagle, True) >>> Visits(Rabbit, BaldEagle, True) ::: If something visits the rabbit and it needs the bald eagle then the rabbit visits the bald eagle.

Visits($x, Rabbit, True) >>> Needs(Rabbit, BaldEagle, True) ::: If something visits the rabbit then the rabbit needs the bald eagle.
Visits($x, Lion, True) && Needs(Lion, Dog, True) >>> Needs($x, Dog, True) ::: If something visits the lion and the lion needs the dog then it needs the dog.

Needs(Dog, Dog, True) ::: The dog needs the dog.
